plan: My value is $49. Since this is the only round, I want to maximize my expected profit. Given the possible values range from $0 to $49, a bid slightly above $49 is not beneficial as I can't profit if I win. I will bid $49. This ensures I win if any other bidder values the item below $49, and I only lose if someone else values it higher.

Since this is a single-round auction, and my value is $44, I want to bid slightly above what I expect the second-highest bid to be, without exceeding my value too much. Given the possible range of values (0-49), a conservative approach is to bid $44.10. This minimizes the risk of overpaying while maximizing the chance of winning if other bidders have lower values.
